name: Berghof
beschreibung: The Berghof is located in Neustift im Stubaital, an established holiday area in Tirol. The hotel offers various room and suite categories. The location provides access to hiking trails and, in winter, to the ski areas of the Stubaital. The property has a wellness area with sauna and steam bath. The dining facilities include a restaurant serving Tiroler cuisine. Guests can book half board. Neustift itself offers infrastructure with shops and leisure facilities. The Berghof is suitable for guests who want to spend an active holiday.
